FIR Against Abhishek Banerjee Over 'Revenge' Remark

An FIR has been registered against Abhishek Banerjee following his statement about taking revenge if the government changes, with a specific mention of BJP offices not surviving. This statement was made in reference to a 2031 timeline. Separately, Chief Minister Shuvendu Adhikari issued a warning to Banerjee in the assembly, stating he would not be able to get out after going to jail once.
